description: This file defines the 'RepoSpec' struct and associated functions for parsing and handling git repository specifications, including URL parsing, path splitting, and clone specifications within the 'kustomize' project.

classes.name: RepoSpec
classes.description: Struct representing a git repository specification, including host, path, branch, submodules, and timeout.

methods.name: CloneSpec
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for 'git clone', combining host and repo path.

methods.name: CloneDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the repository is cloned.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Returns the raw URL or string used to create the RepoSpec.

methods.name: AbsPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the kustomization root within the cloned repo.

methods.name: Cleaner
methods.description: Returns a cleanup function to remove the clone directory.

methods.name: NewRepoSpecFromURL
methods.description: Parses a git-like URL string into a RepoSpec object, extracting host, path, branch, and other parameters.
